Natuurlijk kunnen er zaken beter, vast wel. Maar voor mijn doeleinden is Apple Notes perfect. Met aan paar mappen en een bergje aan ‘tags’ kan ik alles wat ik wil doen. Zeker sinds de iOS 17 versie ook inter-note-links ondersteund. 

Ik heb er ook een 15 Apple Shortcuts / Opdrachten omheen gebouwd om het een en ander voor mij te automatiseren.

title: Lots of bugs
body: Wonderful app for taking notes! Simple yet efficient and has everything I need. Though lately there are a lot of bugs which really disrupt my workflow, maybe my own device is the problem but I don’t think so. Here are some of them: writing glitch when writing with apple pen while hand rests on screen, toolbar is cut off when clicking on the write/draw button in some cases, long notes get glitchy and are impossible to work with. I hope apple can do something about this, then it would be a 5-star worthy app.

title: Underrated.
body: I don’t know why y’all are having problems with it but it’s literally so good. I almost never give 5 stars but this app really deserves this it has such a low rating. I don’t know if you guys just have high af standards but what else do you need??? Plus if it’s one glitch you don’t immediately have to give it 2 stars. Everyone app has glitches. But moving on the app itself is so good. You can add photos you can vent you can even lock some notes and have different passwords. You can have important information on it. And you can make it look so pretty. It’s literally so great. Very very underrated.
